note: Electric-only RV sites at the City of Torrington's Cottonwood municipal golf course, under cottonwoods beside the course; arrive with full fresh water and empty holding tanks. The city's golf pages say nothing about the RV sites, so call the pro shop first. Camper-reported rate: $25 a night in June 2025 (RV LIFE review). --Claude
summary: Weak presence: neither the city page nor the golf site mentions RV camping; the only evidence is RV LIFE (7 sites, 30/50 A electric, no water/sewer, $25/night, one review dated June 2025: 'We parked here for 4 nights. 30/50 Amp power.'). Kept on that dated review + the pro-shop phone (Montana precedent), with a call-first note and a camper-reported rate. Season and reservable flag on file are unsourced.
